'''Zapal''' was a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] elite infantry [[Commander/Legends|commander]] who participated in the [[Invasion of Manaan]].<ref name="TOR:Decimation"/>
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The player only interacts with Zapal if they sided with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], where they will be tasked with killing a squad of elite Republic troops lead by Zapal.<ref name="TOR:Decimation"/>
